notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). The skill shows nginx and Traefik reverse-proxy configuration: HTTPS redirect and TLS settings, security headers, path-based routing, WebSockets, rate limiting, compression, Let's Encrypt via certbot, Traefik static/dynamic/Docker-label config, nginx management commands and IP allowlisting.

Medium: the agent may run `sudo apt install certbot python3-certbot-nginx` and `sudo certbot --nginx` (SKILL.md:188-191), which installs packages, requests certificates from Let's Encrypt and edits nginx config, plus `sudo nginx -t` / `sudo nginx -s reload` (SKILL.md:347-350). Acceptable because these are standard, user-requested steps on the user's own proxy host; the guidance tightens security (TLS 1.2+, HSTS, rate limits, allowlists) and nothing disables security controls or deletes data.

Review before adopting: the Traefik compose example mounts /var/run/docker.sock read-only into the proxy container (SKILL.md:316), which grants significant host visibility; `nginx -s status` (SKILL.md:353) is not a valid nginx signal. Related Skills (SKILL.md:401-404) link to sibling skills ../load-balancing/, ../cdn-setup/, ../dns-management/ and ../service-mesh/ as optional reading only.
